whatsNew.summary: Work connects multiple agent sessions to one task, with Connections and Agent workspace together. Matched with server 6.73.3.

sections.title: Shared work
items: Link existing Claude, Codex and Cursor sessions to a shared task. Each session keeps its own progress.
View each contributor in Agent workspace while retaining Continue, Fork and Start a new session.
Open exact Claude and Codex chats, copy session IDs, and remove individual links without deleting chats. Cursor opens its Agents view.

sections.title: A quieter board
items: Use Your move for decisions, Board for active stages, and History for hidden notices.
Hide stale notices and restore them from History. Delivery warnings and task stages stay intact.
Copy task IDs and context for work across sessions. Shared task completion remains your decision.
